descriptionMarkdown:
Ships for different stages of the game.

Smart astroid handling, smart reprocessing recipe, speed control, compact layout, no quality, stress tested. 

Basic: travel to Vulcanus, Gleba, pause between stops to stock ammo.

Intermediate: travel to Vulcanus, Gleba, Fulgora, pause between stops to stock ammo.

Advanced: travel to all planets, no pauses.

They need different level of damage upgrade researches, read description for more.


Edit:
27/04/2026: Modified advanced ships to only require Stronger explosives 8 (was 12)
